title: ‘Hangry’ Woman Fight Cops After Cutting Movie Theater Snack Line
description:
Bodycam footage shows a woman being arrested for allegedly biting, kicking, and spitting at officers after she was trespassed from a movie theater in Paramus, New Jersey. Police arrested Ladonna Nathan, 28, after employees called police to report a woman acting erratic, saying she allegedly skipped the concession line and started shaking the POS system. Investigators later discovered she came to the movie with a man who has special needs and ended up behind bars. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
